correctness.rationale: Laurent polynomial identity proves exact mod-nine ternary recurrences; induction handles no two, unique two and at least two cases. The sentinel-transition bijection proves exact binomial counts, and roots of unity give matching upper and lower discrepancy bounds for every sufficiently large L. Independent exact integer recurrence verifies 6561 terms and nine complete histograms through L=8; finite calculations supplement rather than establish the proof.

value.rationale: Complete residue frequencies modulo nine refine a natural established classification from mere divisibility to every attainable class at the smallest nontrivial square prime power. The three unit classes live on the ternary Cantor support and have a sharp, nonconstant Θ(3^{L/2}) discrepancy; the result gives an exact structural arithmetic invariant, not a tiny numerical gain or a relabeling of zero-class counts.
